csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode; public class FixPlayerSpawn { public static string Run() { var oldSpawns = Object.FindObjectsOfType<NetworkStartPosition>(); if (oldSpawns.Length > 0) return "Already has NetworkStartPosition: " + oldSpawns[0].transform.position; GameObject go = new GameObject("PlayerSpawnPoint"); NetworkStartPosition nsp = go.AddComponent<NetworkStartPosition>(); UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshHit hit; if (UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.SamplePosition(Vector3.zero, out hit, 500f, UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.AllAreas)) { go.transform.position = hit.position + Vector3.up * 2f; } else { go.transform.position = new Vector3(0, 10f, 0); } UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene()); return "Created NetworkStartPosition at " + go.transform.position; } }
